title: Focus Group: From mouse to human - follow the genetic signal!
bodyHtml:
Want an inside look at how statistical enrichment can bridge the gap between mouse phenotypes and human traits?Join us at our focus group to explore:
✔️ An open access resource that enables mouse to human trait linkage, available through the Common Fund Data Ecosystem
? Statistical validation of our methods to directly inform and strengthen the interactive module
? How to use the Common Fund Data Ecosystem’s Knowledge Center to aid your research!

Session details:
? Thursday, January 8th, 2026
⏰ 12-1 PM ET
? https://broadinstitute.zoom.us/j/98488007830?pwd=97a4cemrTfo5GJ2T0zLcjSy8StmYxL.1

summary: Join us Thursday, January 8th, 2026 from 12-1 PM ET for our focus group centered around mouse to human phenotypes.
